paper_title: The macrophage-derived motor protein KIF13B enhances MERTK-mediated efferocytosis and prevents atherosclerosis in mice
study_design: Mechanistic translational preclinical study combining associative human arterial and plaque observations with mouse atherosclerosis genetics, public and study-generated transcriptomics, macrophage experiments, genetic rescue and pharmacologic intervention.
evidence_type: Human tissue association; causal mouse and macrophage experiments; public dataset reanalysis; preclinical pharmacologic rescue.
claim: KIF13B expression is lower in advanced human arterial and carotid lesions and in progressing mouse plaques.
context: Human findings are associative, not evidence that manipulating KIF13B changes human atherosclerosis.
reported_evidence: [{"label":"GSE40231","value":"40 non-atherosclerotic and 40 atherosclerotic arterial-wall samples showed lower KIF13B in atherosclerotic tissue."},{"label":"Human carotid tissue","value":"Early n=6 and advanced n=6 lesions showed lower KIF13B protein in advanced plaques, with macrophage co-localization."},{"label":"Mouse progression","value":"Ldlr-deficient mice, n=6 per group, showed lower plaque KIF13B after 20 versus 12 weeks of Western diet."}]
source_locator: Results: The expression of KIF13B is negatively correlated with the progression of atherosclerosis in patients and mice; Figure 1 and Supplementary Figure S1.
scope_does_not_establish: ["Human KIF13B causality, prediction of clinical outcomes or human atherosclerosis treatment efficacy.","That the global Ldlr-deficient knockout plaque phenotype is lipid independent.","Macrophage-exclusive effects of Lyz2-Cre deletion or bone-marrow transplantation, or five independent single-cell libraries from five pooled mice.","One definitive diet duration for the study-generated pooled aortic single-cell comparison, because Results and Figure 3E disagree.","That MERTK restoration is an effective in vivo or human therapy, or that every proposed ITCH-to-CBL ubiquitination and degradation step has been directly resolved.","That NX-1607 reverses 20 weeks of established disease, has proven human atherosclerosis benefit, or unequivocally validates endogenous CBL rather than the distinct CBLB target described by external sources."]
